# Lower inflation doesn't spell relief. Here’s why.

August 18, 2026•4 min read

Author: Nela Richardson, Ph.D.

Hard data and personal perceptions don’t always tell the same story about the economy.

Last week, we learned that the pace of inflation cooled in July. But we also saw consumer sentiment fall 12.4 percent in August from the previous year.
